what: next/ version. The P18 slice 1 lane (one window client for the browser and headless) cost $75.15 at list price against its plan's estimate of 5 steps, $9, so it passed 0076's stop at twice the estimate after the first tests and build steps. The lead chose to finish: the lane was close and the desk lane stacks on it. Every step ran as a Claude Opus subagent, with 20M to 80M cache-read tokens each; the build alone was $27.95 over three rounds. The lane also took four tests rounds: the build sent back four laws no product could pass, then CI's real round trip found the headless test key hashing the SSH blob in place of the raw key.
cause: The plan priced its steps from field/runs.jsonl medians, which are mostly Codex runs in boxes; an Opus subagent reading the whole repo context costs several times that per step. No estimate source names the model it was measured on.
fix: The plan's Estimate line names the model, and its medians come from rows of that same model and role; chain.ts's budget check compares against the right base.
test: Property: for any set of priced run rows with mixed models, the estimate for a model uses only that model's rows, and is null when there are none.
